result:
If I could change just one thing, it would be to make the cost of harm visible and felt immediately.

Not in a punitive way, but so that no one can hurt, exploit, or deceive another without instantly understanding, in a real and visceral way, what that does to the person on the other side. 

If cruelty, indifference, and dishonesty were as impossible to sustain as trying to lie to someone while looking them in the eye, the rest of the world would reorganize itself pretty quickly.
